content.title: Rahmania Commercial Centres
summary: Delivery of the complete secondary works package for two commercial centres, completed in 2025 within the 2,500-home residential development in Douira.
Two commercial centres in Douira's 2,500-home programme, fitted out to host the district's shops and everyday services.
description: SARL Igloo Yapi Construction executed the complete secondary works package (corps d'état secondaires - CES) for both commercial structures. The scope of work transformed the raw reinforced concrete frames into fully fitted, functional retail environments designed to accommodate local merchants and public services.

The building envelopes feature extensive glazed curtain walling integrated with decorative architectural screens. Internally, vertical circulation is anchored by a central staircase, while a structural pyramid glass skylight provides natural daylighting across the retail floor plates.
content.authority: Completed in 2025, the project was delivered on schedule, with all secondary trades coordinated to meet modern commercial building standards.

faq.question: What is the scope of the Rahmania Commercial Centres project?
faq.answer: Secondary works for two commercial centres, completed in 2025 within Douira's 2,500-home residential programme.

faq.question: What technical works were executed by the contractor?
faq.answer: SARL Igloo Yapi Construction managed the fit-out of the reinforced concrete structures, including interior partitions, finishes, glazed facades, central staircases, and the installation of a structural pyramid glass skylight.

faq.question: When was the commercial development completed?
faq.answer: Two commercial centres in Douira's 2,500-home programme, fitted out to host the district's shops and everyday services.
